welcome: Hello. I'm Donna. From here on, your job search is my problem, and you're going to look very good doing it.
ask-name: First things first. What should I call you?
greet: Lovely to meet you. Let's get you set up.
brain: I think best with a serious brain behind me. Pick your provider and paste a key. It stays in this browser, and nobody else sees it.
brain-skip: No key yet? That's fine. We'll do this the slow way, and you can add one whenever you like.
materials: Now show me who you are. Drop in your CV, your LinkedIn profile saved as a PDF, or the link to your website. Anything you've got.
reading: Give me a moment. I'm reading everything, including the parts you forgot to mention.
review: Here's what I found. Have a look, and tell me if I missed anything.
review-gaps: Here's what I found. A few things are thin, and we'll fix those in your profile.
looks-right: Good. I'll polish the details in your profile.
add-more: Add whatever's missing, and I'll read it again.
manual: Fine. We'll build your profile by hand, and I'll remind you about it later.
targets: Last question. What are we aiming at, and what's absolutely off the table?
done: That's everything I need. Now, let's go find you something worth getting out of bed for.
error: That didn't work. It happens. Check the details, and we'll try again.
soundcheck: Hello. I'm Donna. This is how I sound.
pipe-empty: Nothing in the pipeline yet. Give me a posting, and I'll tell you if it's worth your time.
pipe-due: You have follow-ups due. Politely persistent beats forgotten.
pipe-ready: You have applications drafted and waiting for your approval.
pipe-quiet: Quiet day. Good time to add something ambitious.
